exchanges: ugh mondays. first full week back at the hospital after the holidays
Welcome back, hope the week goes easy on you.
they finally moved me off general imaging, im officially a sonographer now lol
Congrats, that's a huge step up!
my partner anselm made pancakes to celebrate, hes the best
That's so sweet, what a nice way to mark it.
and then quillon stole one right off the counter, that dog has no shame
Ha, no pancake is safe around a determined pup.
weather is gross today, sleet everywhere
Sleet is miserable, stay dry out there.
at least i take the tram so no scraping the windshield
Skipping the ice scraper is a real perk.
my mom wants us all over for dinner sunday
Sounds like a cozy family night.
my sister just started at the brightwater aquarium, she gets to feed the otters
Feeding otters sounds like a dream gig.
kinda jealous ngl, i just stare at ultrasound screens all day
Your screens help a lot of people though!
the dog is a vizsla so he needs to run for hours every day
Those high-energy breeds really keep you moving.
took him to the river trail after work, im wiped
Sounds like you both earned a good rest.
oh and my sister-in-law got hired at halloway bakery downtown
Nice, free pastries for the family hopefully!
so now both of them have cooler jobs than me haha
Hey, yours is pretty impressive too.
ferris from work is weirdly obsessed with archery lately, he showed me videos of his form for ages
Sounds like he's found his thing.
lunch was a sad desk salad
Desk salads are rough, hope dinner makes up for it.
my sister is slogging through middlemarch for her book club and complaining nonstop
Classic novels can be a slog, hope she makes it to the end.
thinking about a lazy weekend honestly
A lazy weekend sounds well deserved.
my wrist has been killing me, doc says its tendinitis from the probe
Ouch, hope it settles down with some rest.
gotta wear a brace at work now which is so annoying
That's a pain, but hopefully it helps it heal faster.
odile finally ditched the bus and got a skoda, shes thrilled
Good for her, no more waiting at the stop!
she offered me rides but honestly my way in is quicker
Hard to beat a quick routine.
basement smells kinda musty, been worried about mold
Musty smells are worth jumping on early.
so i grabbed a dehumidifier on the way home, hoping it helps
Good call, that should dry things out.
ok time to crash, night!
Goodnight, sleep well!

remind me whats my new title at the hospital
which show has my sister been watching
